messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone surface, then performs a dance by raising her arms, bending her knees, and turning her body before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, medium full-body shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A red bikini with a yellow star pattern, an open matching sheer robe, and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Long, straight hair with straight bangs across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slender build, fair skin, and a stylized anime-like face.","scene":"An outdoor cobblestone area in a fantasy setting, with stone buildings, a large castle on a cliff, and a tree branch visible in the upper right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output retains the same red-haired character, red star-patterned bikini and robe, pink sneakers, dance action, outdoor castle scene, and static camera. The face remains similar to the source and does not visibly match the reference photo's facial identity.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person in the video with the person from the reference photo, using the reference for facial identity and matching body skin tone, while keeping hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether subtle facial features were altered is difficult to judge from the provided frames.
unexpected_changes: The output appears to be essentially the same as the source, with no clear identity replacement.
